mechanismOfAction.summary: SNAP-25 N-terminal mimic; inhibits SNARE complex to reduce muscle contraction ('topical Botox').
mechanismOfAction.description: Acetylated hexapeptide mimicking the N-terminus of SNAP-25. Competes for SNARE-complex assembly, attenuating catecholamine/acetylcholine release at the neuromuscular junction to soften expression lines.
